summary: Phase 2 verified end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases PASS (100%) on POST /api/documents/{id}/submissions — 201 with populated field_count (3 & 0), 404 on unknown id, 403 without bearer token, signature_b64 accepted verbatim, Mongo `submissions` row shape complete {document_id, document_title, submitted_by, submitter_email, submitter_role, values, signature_b64, submitted_at}, GET /schema regression still green. Frontend: Supabase login (admin@healthguard.com/AdminPassword123!) → Documents tab → SKilleRN-Fillable.pdf card shows fill-doc-<id> pencil next to view-doc eye. Tapping opens Modal with header 'SKilleRN-Fillable' + subtitle '182 fields · 4 pages' + 'PAGE 1 OF 4' pill; 142 dyn-field TextInputs, 12 dyn-radio chips, 33 dyn-check chips, and 1 'Signature capture coming soon' placeholder rendered. Filled 3 TextInputs + 1 checkbox + 1 radio → dyn-form-submit → POST 201 → Modal closes → Mongo row confirms values persisted. Legacy _LegacyEmploymentForm.tsx preserved with rollback docstring & guarded by {false && (…)}. No HTML tags, no web-form libs in DynamicFormRenderer.tsx. KeyboardAvoidingView + ScrollView wired.

ui_bugs.issue: React key-collision warnings on modal mount for SKilleRN-Fillable — inside f.options.map((opt) => <Pressable key={opt}>) options can repeat within a single field's option list (e.g. duplicate 'YES'). Suggest key={`${opt}-${idx}`}. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/DynamicFormRenderer.tsx:248, 300, 344, 372

issues: fill-doc-<id> button is gated by hasFile — spec's 'metadata-only doc' scenario is not reachable via UI (button hidden). This matches eye-icon 'view' gating and is likely intentional; noted only because the spec explicitly requested testing that scenario.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Fix duplicate-key React warning by using composite keys (opt+idx) in the four .options.map((opt) => <Pressable key={opt}>) sites inside DynamicFormRenderer.tsx.

OPTIONAL: Decide whether the fill-doc-<id> pencil should also render for metadata-only docs (currently gated by hasFile). If yes, drop the hasFile guard on line 382 of documents.tsx so users can still open the empty-state modal.
critical_code_review_comments: DynamicFormRenderer is self-contained, uses React Native primitives only, no web libs. Grep clean.

Legacy _LegacyEmploymentForm.tsx preserved verbatim, exports FillableFormModal, docstring reads 'Preserved as a rollback … Do NOT delete', imported into documents.tsx but rendered only inside {false && (...)} — rollback path warm without mount cost.

Backend POST /submissions correctly 404s on missing doc, requires auth, persists document_title snapshot + submitter role, computes field_count as count of populated values (excludes '', None, False, [], {}).
